The liver is one of the primary blood reservoirs in the
body, and can store 200–400 mL of blood.4 If an individual 
hemorrhages, and large amounts of blood are lost from the 
circulatory system, much of the blood normally in the liver
sinusoids drains into the general circulation to help replace
blood loss.
